title: Mirror Featuring Deities and Kings in Three Sections Surrounded by Rings of Squares and Semicircles
text_changes: None; translated fields and remarks reproduced verbatim

passages.text:
I made this bright mirror 
By refining the three metals. 
With my fine skill, I engraved [the design].
passages.source_text: 吾作明鏡，幽涑三岡。巧工刻之。

note: Complete museum-published inscription rendering; AncientLens scholarly review remains unreviewed. Museum transcription supplies three maker/engraving clauses and the description repeats all three English clauses.
